title: Every posterior median minimizes absolute posterior risk
statement: With finite posterior first absolute moment, every posterior median minimizes absolute posterior risk; the measurable lower-median rule is an attained Bayes action rule.
strategy: Compare risks on the intervals separated by the median and use the two half-mass inequalities.

references.title: Ryan Martin, Lecture Notes on Advanced Statistical Theory, §5.3.1, PDF pp. 104–105
Alicia A. Johnson, Miles Q. Ott, and Mine Dogucu, Bayes Rules!, Chapter 8 §8.1
